defect.description: Input_args given as ordinary ffmpeg arguments in a string rather than a preset name (for example '-rtsp_transport tcp') are concatenated as a str onto the argument list: get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) + '-rtsp_transport tcp' raises TypeError (can only concatenate list to list), so audio detection fails to start; the fallbacks need get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) like the global args.

review_items: TypeError when input_args is a plain string of ffmpeg arguments (raw fallbacks concatenated to list)
Empty list input_args=[] falls through to camera-wide fallback
detect_fps=1 injects -r 1 for preset-http-reolink in audio
IndexError when no input has audio role (pre-existing pattern)
votes.evidence_quote: When `ffmpeg_input.input_args = "-rtsp_transport tcp"` (a valid input per the config docs), `parse_preset_input()` returns `None` (line 19: `arg not in PRESETS_INPUT`), then `or ffmpeg_input.input_args` yields the raw string `"-rtsp_transport tcp"`. Concatenating `list[str] + str` on line 15 raises `TypeError`.
votes.justification: The review identifies the same defect: plain-string input_args fall through to raw string fallbacks, which are concatenated onto a list in get_ffmpeg_command and raise TypeError. It also proposes the known fix of wrapping the fallbacks in get_ffmpeg_arg_list().
